_doc: 美术资产清单 = 唯一真相源。tools/art_audit.gd 据此列出缺失资产并生成提示词；tools/import_art.gd 据此把 art_inbox/ 里的图片处理成游戏资产；tools/art_studio.gd（GPT 工作室）据此生成。美术方向：二次元 × 仙侠立绘 × 哥特未来（见 references/visual-system.md §1）。所有角色都是成年人。新增基因部件/骨架/生态区/状态/卡牌时必须在这里补规格，test_data 会检查。mode: cutout=保留原色并去背景（角色立绘和配饰部件用这个）；color=保留原色不去背景；mono=白色剪影图标（运行时着色）；palette=灰度绘制+运行时按种族上色（旧的怪物风格，保留兼容）。bodies.*.subject = 我方种族角色（多数是女性），bodies.*.enemy_subject = 敌方反派版本（更高大、更强、明显的反派画风）。

race_art.human: Human Sect motifs: midnight-blue and silver silk, white jade, polished steel filigree, azure glowing circuit embroidery
race_art.insect: Insect race motifs: glossy crimson-and-black chitin plates, wine-red silk, gothic black lace, iridescent translucent membranes, amber lens accents
race_art.fungal: Fungal race motifs: ivory and moss-green fabrics, soft mushroom-cap textures with gently glowing spots, delicate mycelium lace, pastel bioluminescence
race_art.beast: Beast race motifs: carved bone ornaments, silver-grey fur trim, dark leather, glowing amber tribal tattoos and runes
race_art.crystal: Crystal race motifs: faceted ice-blue crystal, porcelain-white panels, prismatic glass, cyan glowing light lines
race_art.wraith: Wraith race motifs: tattered black-violet veils, misty translucent ectoplasm, pale silver ornaments, eerie violet glow

sash.subject: a diagonal ceremonial silk sash with a white-jade rally badge pinned on it and short silver tassels, lying flat, running from upper left to lower right, the sash alone

plating.subject: an ornamental armored corset front made of three overlapping polished steel plates with silver filigree and azure light lines, lying flat, the armor piece alone

satchel.subject: a small elegant medic pouch of dark leather with silver clasps, a softly glowing azure cross emblem and a short strap stub, the pouch alone

spear.subject: a long ornate xianxia spear lying diagonally from lower left to upper right: a slender dark lacquered shaft with silver rings and a red tassel, a leaf-shaped glowing steel blade at the upper right end, the weapon alone with no hand

banner.subject: a tall back-mounted war banner: a slim pole standing upright with a long embroidered silk pennant hanging from its top on the left side, the pole's bottom end at the bottom of the image, no person

eye_compound.subject: a sleek visor of hexagonal amber compound lenses in a slim black chitin frame, seen from the side, like a futuristic insect eyepiece, the visor alone
eye_compound.accent: a small glint at the center of each facet

shell_plate.subject: a pair of folded glossy crimson chitin wing-cases with gothic lace edges and an iridescent sheen, about twice as wide as tall, the wings alone

sac.subject: a venom vial pendant: one bulbous translucent glass-like sac with veins, held in black chitin filigree, the pendant alone
sac.accent: the small pool of liquid in the lower half of the sac

spray_nozzle.subject: a sleek chitin wrist-mounted sprayer gauntlet lying horizontally, its cuff at the left edge and a fine nozzle pointing right, one drop of liquid at the tip, the gauntlet alone

egg_sac.subject: a back-worn cluster of four glossy pearl-like insect eggs bound in a black lace-and-chitin harness, the bundle alone

volatile_sac.subject: an unstable glowing explosive gland orb held in a cracked chitin cage, the orb alone

mandible.subject: a sleek chitin face-guard mask with a pair of curved serrated mandible blades, seen from the side, its hinge at the left edge and the open mandibles pointing to the right, the mask alone

spore_cap.subject: three small mushroom caps with glowing spots sprouting upward from one shared mossy base at the bottom, like a living shoulder ornament

tendril.subject: a single elegant pale fungal tendril growing horizontally to the right from a soft rounded base at the left edge, gently curling, tapering to a fine hooked tip, about twice as long as it is tall

mycelium_web.subject: a delicate shawl-shaped piece of dense ivory mycelium lace: a roughly round, opaque felted lace mat with fine thread patterns and a few short tufts along its edge, no holes or gaps

bloom.subject: a single large six-petal corpse-flower corsage seen from the front, deep crimson petals, no stem, no leaves

fang.subject: a fanged lower half-mask of carved white bone with two long curved fangs hanging downward, the mask's top edge at the top of the image, the fang tips pointing down, the mask alone

fur_mane.subject: a fluffy silver-grey fur collar-mantle rising upward from a straight base line at the bottom, with spiky tufts, seen from the side

claw.subject: a clawed gauntlet: an ornate bone-and-silver glove with three long curved claws, the cuff at the left edge and the claws pointing to the right, the gauntlet alone

crest.subject: a tiara-like crest of three sharp horn spikes rising upward from one shared ornate bone base at the bottom

halo.subject: a single thick ring halo of ghostly light with fine silver filigree, seen almost edge-on from the side, a flat wide elliptical ring about twice as wide as it is tall, broken by a clear gap at the bottom so the white background inside the ring connects to the outside

ether_veil.subject: a long flowing translucent ghostly veil-cape hanging vertically, its top edge straight with a thin silver clasp line, its lower edge in ragged tatters, the cloth alone with no person

soul_claw.subject: three long spectral claw blades of violet ghost light fanning out to the right from one shared ornate silver root at the left edge

biped.subject: a young adult woman of the Human Sect, a graceful cultivator-knight: long black hair in a half-up bun with a white jade hairpin, calm confident gaze, a midnight-blue hanfu-inspired dress with a high side slit, an off-shoulder translucent outer robe with wide flowing sleeves and silver filigree, a fitted gothic corset bodice, thin azure glowing circuit embroidery along the hems, elegant heeled boots

hexapod.subject: a young adult woman of the Insect race: long wavy wine-red hair with two slender antennae rising from her head, amber eyes, a glossy crimson-and-black chitin-plated gown with gothic black lace, a high-collared fitted bodice and a long skirt with a high slit, sheer black lace sleeves, chitin heels
